prompt:
PLAN 06 | GO WITHOUT ME
DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9

CHARACTER REFERENCES
{{CHAR_ARMAYIL_COOK}} <<<image_3>>> 
{{CHAR_GARMAYIL_COOK}} <<<image_4>>> 
{{CHAR_OLDER_BROTHER}} <<<image_1>>> 
{{CHAR_YOUNGER_BROTHER}} <<<image_2>>> 

LOCATION REFERENCES
{{LOC_PREP_ROOM}} <<<image_5>>> 

PROP REFERENCES
{{PROP_ESCAPE_ROBE}} <<<image_6>>> 
{{PROP_WORK_STOOL}}

Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence with the precisely timed shots below. Preserve each referenced identity, body proportions, costume and rigid handmade mask. Masks stay fixed to the head with stable features and eye openings; emotion is performed through the body, eyes where visible, breath and hands. All characters are adults. Each listed cut changes the specified physical camera position, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement responds to the actor and follows a possible path in the set; keep the key action readable and focus engaged. Use hard cuts at listed shot boundaries. References anchor design; the written lighting defines exposure and illumination. Preserve the tactile Iranian-inspired world and restrained natural exposure.

LOCATION AND LIGHT
Enclosed preparation room with a NORTH main door, EAST work counter and WEST narrow service exit. One hard neutral ceiling practical and weak warmer west-wall spill illuminate a continuous level floor. Old Iranian masonry, rounded openings and engineered lamps. Keep fixed exposure and light direction across all angles. A plain low wooden work stool stands near the central floor.

START STATE AND BLOCKING
Older stands center-left facing Younger center-right; Garmayil is just behind Younger at right holding the single robe ready. Armayil stands left beside the west exit. Main door north remains closed. Camera works at arm’s length south of the brothers’ east-west eyeline axis, using short partial arcs within that half-space.


SHOT 06A | 0s to 3s | 3 seconds
35mm intimate handheld two-shot from south. Younger right grabs Older’s forearms and tries to pull him toward the west exit. Older left resists, catches Younger’s upper arms and turns him back toward Garmayil. Camera sways with their shifting weight, looking for the decision in their hands and faces.

SHOT 06B | 3s to 5s | 2 seconds
65mm Older close-up from beside Younger’s near shoulder. Older faces right, his mask fixed, breath breaking. He releases a strained wordless cry, points insistently toward the escape opening and presses Younger away from himself. This is a frightened act of will, not serene sacrifice.

SHOT 06C | 5s to 7s | 2 seconds
65mm reverse Younger close-up from beside Older’s near shoulder, staying south of the axis. Younger faces left, shakes his head, cries and leans back toward his brother. Camera comes too close for a moment and corrects, maintaining focus on his eyes or visible eye openings as defined by the reference.

SHOT 06D | 7s to 10s | 3 seconds
28mm close moving three-shot from southeast. Older left pulls Younger center into one brief fierce embrace, then physically turns him toward Garmayil right. Garmayil catches Younger with an open supporting arm and raises the robe around his shoulders. Camera travels a short arc behind the near edge of Older’s shoulder, staying on the south side.

SHOT 06E | 10s to 12s | 2 seconds
40mm close from southwest on Armayil at the west service opening. He opens the narrow exit, listens into it and urgently motions them over. His other hand braces against the wall; his breathing and repeated glance back toward Older reveal distress.

SHOT 06F | 12s to 15s | 3 seconds
35mm low close two-shot from south-center. Older left pushes Younger right toward Garmayil’s supporting arm, then lets his sleeve slip from Younger’s grip. Camera drops to the separating hands and tilts immediately back up. Garmayil pulls the robe fully across Younger’s shoulders; Older remains in the room.

END STATE AND EDIT
Younger wears the single escape robe across his shoulders but has not yet left. Garmayil supports him. The west service exit is open; Armayil holds the way clear. Older remains center-left, terrified and committed.

SOUND
Strained wordless cries, quick breath, hands gripping cloth, robe movement and the service latch. Emotion is urgent and vocal but without spoken words.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.
